mapper.select: SELECT rg.region_id AS regionId, rg.region_name AS regionName, rg.short_name AS shortName, ROUND(fc.predicted_kwh / 1000000) AS predictedGwh, ROUND((fc.predicted_kwh / fc.prev_year_kwh - 1) * 100, 1) AS yoyPct, acc.mape AS mape, acc.rmseGwh AS rmseGwh, acc.maeGwh AS maeGwh FROM region rg JOIN forecast fc ON fc.region_id = rg.region_id JOIN (SELECT year AS y, month AS m FROM forecast ORDER BY year, month LIMIT 1) first ON fc.year = first.y AND fc.month = first.m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bt.region_id, ROUND(AVG(ABS(bt.predicted_kwh - bt.actual_kwh) / bt.actual_kwh) * 100, 2) AS mape, ROUND(SQRT(AVG(POW(bt.predicted_kwh - bt.actual_kwh, 2))) / 1000000, 1) AS rmseGwh, ROUND(AVG(ABS(bt.predicted_kwh - bt.actual_kwh)) / 1000000, 1) AS maeGwh FROM backtest bt GROUP BY bt.region_id ) acc ON acc.region_id = rg.region_id ORDER BY predictedGwh DESC
